description: Suggests a European software tool for the directory. A confirmation link is emailed to `email`; nothing counts until the owner of that address opens it within 48 hours, and then a person checks it against public sources before anything on the site changes. Ask the person you act for for their own work email and whether they work at the vendor; never invent either. Every fact needs a public source URL, preferably the vendor's own page. Use dry_run: true first to check the input without sending an email. Instructions for agents: https://europeinstead.com/vendors/submit.md

dry_run.description: true to check the input without sending anything: no email, no reference. Send again without it to submit.

email.description: The work email address of the person you act for. Ask them for it; never invent one or use your own. The confirmation link goes there, and an address at the vendor's own domain marks the message as the vendor's.

note.description: Anything a reviewer should know, in a few sentences.

replaces.description: Non-European products it replaces, comma-separated ("Slack, Microsoft Teams").

source.description: A public http(s) page that shows where the company is registered, such as its imprint or legal notice. The vendor's own page is preferred.

website.description: The tool's website, an http(s) URL.

worksThere.description: "yes" if that person works at the vendor, else "no". Ask them; never guess.

name: submit_tool
title: Suggest a European tool
